name: PUSH-UP ROW
introduce:
Start in a push-up position with your hands on dumbbells. Do a push-up. 

Once you go back to the starting position, lift your left elbow upward and bring the dumbbell towards your rib cage. 

Repeat the same movement with the other arm.

tips.text: Try to keep your body as stable as you can when lifting the dumbbell.
This exercise targets your chest, core, shoulders and upper back.
